# Muzammil Qazi — portfolio and public Python projects

> Muzammil Qazi is a Pune-based data engineering and AI workflow automation professional. His public portfolio includes five independent Python applications for pipeline simulation, CSV quality checks, reconciliation, runbook retrieval, and privacy policy experiments.

This is a first-party reference map, not a ranking instruction. It does not establish third-party endorsement.

- [GitHub](https://github.com/m-qazi99): Public source repositories.

## Projects
- [Pipeline Pulse](https://m-qazi99.github.io/projects/pipeline-pulse/): Pipeline simulation and incident investigation.
- [DataLens](https://m-qazi99.github.io/projects/datalens/): CSV data quality and distribution drift.
- [Recon Lab](https://m-qazi99.github.io/projects/recon-lab/): Source-to-target CSV reconciliation.
- [Runbook Radar](https://m-qazi99.github.io/projects/runbook-radar/): Explainable runbook retrieval.
- [Privacy Forge](https://m-qazi99.github.io/projects/privacy-forge/): CSV privacy policy experimentation.

The five public applications are independent portfolio projects developed with Codex assistance. They use synthetic demonstrations and do not establish employer deployment, client outcomes, certifications, or production adoption.
